verdict.rationale: ADK is a code-first framework where CLI/API (adk run, adk deploy) and a built-in Web UI both exist, but the evidence doesn't show full parity — the dev UI is described as for testing/debugging/showcasing without confirmation that every UI action (e.g. evaluation dashboards, deployment config) has an equivalent programmatic path, and no OpenAPI/API spec was found (probe returned 404s). missing for 10: explicit API/CLI parity documentation for every UI feature, a public API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that UI-only features don't exist.
